$comment: The RGY1 section kinds and their encodings. docs/rgy1.md is the normative text; tools/generate-sections.run.ts writes lib/rgy1/sections.generated.ts and crates/registry-core/src/sections.rs from this file, and lib/rgy1/sections.test.ts holds the three equal.

kinds.name: bitset
kinds.count: the number of keys in the key space; the payload holds ceil(count / 8) bytes
kinds.aux: the key arity: 2 or 3 upper-case ASCII letters, or 0 for a three-digit numeric key

kinds.name: id-table
kinds.count: the number of keys in the key space
kinds.aux: the key arity, as for bitset
kinds.value: row id plus one; zero means the key is absent

kinds.name: string-offsets
kinds.count: the number of strings plus one; offsets are monotonic and end at the utf8 section's length

kinds.name: utf8
kinds.count: the byte length; the bytes are strict UTF-8

kinds.name: column
kinds.elementWidth: 1, 2, 4 or 8 bytes; integers unsigned little-endian, 8-byte columns IEEE 754 doubles
kinds.aux: the index into the header's columns list

kinds.name: relation-offsets
kinds.count: the number of source keys plus one
kinds.aux: the index into the header's relations list

kinds.name: relation-targets
kinds.count: the number of targets; each is a row id in the relation's target column set
kinds.aux: the index into the header's relations list
